philippines.title: Cone rues absence of 'best players' after Gilas' worst Asian Games
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas coach Tim Cone acknowledged that it was not able to field the best team possible for its defense of the Asian Games gold that ended on a horrific note by missing a spot in the quarterfinals. Cone and the Philippines’ bid to repeat their dream run three years ago ended on Monday with a 105-61 defeat at the hands of China, not only failing to win but also avoiding a loss of 38 points or more which would have been enough for them to get out of the group stage. philippines.title: Romualdez now behind bars
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — Former House Speaker and Leyte Representative Martin Romualdez is now at the New Quezon City Jail in Barangay Payatas on Monday night. Romualdez came from the Philippine General Hospital (PGH) where he was confined over the weekend. The convoy of Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) personnel from PGH brought Romualdez to the jail facility at 10:49 p.m.  BJMP spokesperson Capt. Jayrex Bustinera confirmed Romualdez’s arrival at the jail facility.  Bustinera said the lawmaker will undergo standard booking procedures such as medical evaluation, fingerprint, mugshot, interview, and orientation.  Earlier, there were reports that Romualdez will arrive at Payatas […]...
Keep on reading: Romualdez now behind bars

philippines.title: Polls to resume in Maluso, Basilan on Sept. 15 after ballot incident
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Elections (Comelec) on Monday said the conduct of the first Bangsamoro Parliamentary elections will resume in Maluso, Basilan on Tuesday, Sept. 15, after flagging reports of compromised ballots. According to Comelec chair George Erwin Garcia, the voting period will still run from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. “The same general instruction ang ipapatupad natin at therefore inaasahan natin na more or less mga 8 ng gabi ay tapos na yung pagbilang doon at pag-transmit ng results,” Garcia said in a press briefing.
